title: Q-STD-prov: Map the provenance ledger to PROV-O
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/open-standards.json::"id": "source-provenance".*"status": "adopted"
**Status:** open

OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): emit ops/provenance.jsonl rows as CloudEvents whose data is PROV-O JSON-LD (Activity, Entity, Agent).

size: M
Out of scope: new formats not in doctrine/open-standards.json.

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation openstd --check passes and the registry row for source-provenance reads adopted with evidence files that exist.
